clues: The chowder was in either Ivan's pail or Tova's.
Tova's pail held the egg salad.
hints: Look at Felix's row. Which of the three lunches could still be his?

Felix did not pack the chowder (clue 1) or the egg salad (Tova's, clue 2). So Felix packed the meatloaf, and Ivan the chowder.

solution.key_idea: Clue 1 keeps the chowder away from Felix, and clue 2 gives the egg salad to Tova, so Felix packed the meatloaf.
steps: Clue 2 puts a dot at Tova and egg salad, with X's across her row and down the egg salad column.
Clue 1 says the chowder was Ivan's or Tova's, so Felix did not pack it.
That leaves Felix only one choice: the meatloaf.
solution.epilogue: Felix ate his own meatloaf at last, Tova her egg salad and Ivan his chowder. By the next morning every pail wore a name label, in Felix's best pencil.

tip: When a clue starts with the lunch instead of the person, read down that lunch's column.
